_comment: Measured timing for the Cendrawasih page. These do NOT come from the
spreadsheet. The anchors were measured against the recording - A, B and C
from Brian, the outro from Brian, b3 and the ending from gong detection.
The sheet's own section timestamps are approximate and disagree.
'sections' records how long each section is and how many times it is played.
The build compares the sheet against this and stops if it differs, because a
section changing length moves the knots below and that has to be re-measured.
knotbars: played-bar positions of the piecewise-linear map's joints.
'start:<section>' resolves to that section's first played bar; 'NB' is the end.
